axes: FBX axis_forward=-Z axis_up=Y, same as bear.fbx. Blender pet-local: front -Y, up +Z, L = -X, paws at z = 0, 1 unit = 1 stud.

conversions.blenderToStudioTemplate: (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, y)  [import template: front -Z]
conversions.note: Same mapping scripts/build_bear_assets.py uses. Meshes are exported with the world transform baked and the pet root at the origin, so each imports at its pet-local position. Studio default FBX units give a uniform 100x MeshSize; Size = MeshSize/100, as for the Bear.

anchorKinds.surface: local +Z leaves the surface; local Y stays close to pet +Y
anchorKinds.face: identity rotation; part modelled pushed out along -Y
anchorKinds.swap: identity rotation; origin at the joint

anchors.name: AnkleL
anchors.note: Sock cuff, anklet. They never wear pants.

anchors.name: AnkleR
anchors.note: Sock cuff, anklet. They never wear pants.

anchors.name: Back
anchors.note: Backpack, cape, shell. Wings and Back items are exclusive.

anchors.name: CheekL
anchors.note: Blush, freckles, whiskers, face stickers.

anchors.name: CheekR
anchors.note: Blush, freckles, whiskers, face stickers.

anchors.name: Chest
anchors.note: Badge, bib, pocket.

anchors.name: ClawL
anchors.note: Paw tip. Feature Egg claws, stages 1-5.

anchors.name: ClawR
anchors.note: Paw tip. Feature Egg claws, stages 1-5.

anchors.name: EyeL
anchors.note: Eye socket centre on the skull. Identity rotation: +Z up, -Y out of the face, so eye textures stay upright.

anchors.name: EyeR
anchors.note: Eye socket centre on the skull. Identity rotation: +Z up, -Y out of the face, so eye textures stay upright.

anchors.name: FaceBridge
anchors.note: Between the eyes: glasses, masks, monocle.

anchors.name: Forehead
anchors.note: Gem, bow, unicorn nub, bandage.

anchors.name: Ground
anchors.note: Shadow blob, aura ring, pedestal. z = 0 is the floor.

anchors.name: HatCrown
anchors.note: Top of skull. Hat origin sits on the crown; brim hangs below. Max radius 0.19 to clear ears unless hidesEars.

anchors.name: HelixL
anchors.note: Upper outer rim. +Z = out along the rim radius; ring clamps the rim in the local YZ plane.

anchors.name: HelixR
anchors.note: Upper outer rim. +Z = out along the rim radius; ring clamps the rim in the local YZ plane.

anchors.name: HornL
anchors.note: +Z leaves the skull. Horn base ring sits on origin, sunk 0.025. Feature Egg stages 1-5.

anchors.name: HornR
anchors.note: +Z leaves the skull. Horn base ring sits on origin, sunk 0.025. Feature Egg stages 1-5.

anchors.name: LobeL
anchors.note: Lower outer rim. Drop earrings hang along world -Z, not local.

anchors.name: LobeR
anchors.note: Lower outer rim. Drop earrings hang along world -Z, not local.

anchors.name: Mouth
anchors.note: Mouth swap (alpha patch or mesh). Expression system owns visibility.

anchors.name: Neck
anchors.note: Necklace ring lies tilted: front 0.03 lower than back.

anchors.name: Nose
anchors.note: Nose swap. On the muzzle tip.

anchors.name: ToeL
anchors.note: Toe claws follow the Claws feature stage.

anchors.name: ToeR
anchors.note: Toe claws follow the Claws feature stage.

anchors.name: Torso
anchors.note: Same point as Body. Shirts are a shell of the shared body mesh; sleeves ride HandL/R.

anchors.name: WristL
anchors.note: Bracelet, watch, cuff. +Z points back up the arm.

anchors.name: WristR
anchors.note: Bracelet, watch, cuff. +Z points back up the arm.

horns.show: exactly one stage per side; L and R always share the stage

wings.colorRole: wingTexture (the Bear's wing map, tinted secondary)
wings.show: exactly one stage per side; S5 is identical to the Bear's existing Bear__WingL/R

exclusions.rule: Hide, never unequip. A blocked item stays owned and selected and returns when the blocker comes off.

oneOf.items: necklace | scarf | collar; draws over a Shirt
default EyeL/R | AltRound | AltSmallWide | AltButton; a swap hides Bear__EyeL/R
default MouthSmile | AltW | AltO; the expression system still picks the frame
species Tail | AltArrow; a swap hides Bear__Tail

notes: Horn stage 4 or 5 lifts CharmFloat by 0.10 so a floating charm clears the tips.
Hat_Beanie is a full hat: coversHorns = true, hidesEars = false.
A shirt is three meshes: Shirt_Torso on Body, Shirt_SleeveL on HandL and Shirt_SleeveR on HandR. The sleeves pivot on the shoulder anchors with the arms and are shown and hidden with the torso.

placeholderNote: Hat_Beanie, Shirt_Torso (+Shirt_SleeveL/R), Neck_Beads, the helix rings, AltButton eyes, AltO mouth and AltArrow tail are grey-box placeholders with the correct size, origin and slot. Horns and wings are review-ready first-pass art.
